title: rourea confundens
intro: Rourea confundens, commonly known as the "Bitterwood" or "Bitterwood tree", is a plant species belonging to the family Connaraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial actions that can be used to treat various health conditions such as fever, cough, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
